Class DeckList

java.lang.Object
parking.DeckList
public class DeckList extends Object
DeckList class that is a resizable array holding the parking decks. The initial capacity is 4, and it grows by 4 whenever the array is full. The capacity never decreases, and closed decks remain in the list.
